key_phrases: long-term gross margin of 53% and higher
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is slightly positive due to strong technology leadership (N3/N5) and long-term margin targets, despite a cautious near-term outlook. The forward guidance tone is negative because management explicitly expects revenue decline in Q1 2023 and continued inventory correction in the first half of 2023. Confidence remains high regarding technological superiority ('N3 will be fully utilized'), though CFO was more evasive on specific cost gaps and near-term margin fluctuations. Quantitative specificity is very high, with detailed breakdowns of revenue by technology, platform, and CapEx allocation. Risk disclosure focuses on macroeconomic weakness and higher overseas construction costs. Demand strength is currently weak in consumer segments (Smartphone/PC) but shows signs of stabilization in HPC/AI.
